articles.summary: When the vineyard wakes up with new growth and buds on the vines, we know it’s time to welcome back our mason bees. In March, Stephen Paisley, Willamette’s “Bee Guy,” and Randy Hillyer, the winery’s Facilities Coordinator, put thousands of mason bee cocoons back into bee houses at Elton Vineyard, Tualatin Estate Vineyard, Bernau Estate […]
articles.title: Mason Bees Return to Willamette Valley Vineyards
